source_semantics_decision: The protected package supports representing five logical ordered positions in a proposed normal-impulse candidate, while candidate generation remains separate from validation. This combined support is not promoted into a new protected definition, rule, principle ID, or validity claim.

protected_sources_observed.boundary: Unsupported methodology remains unresolved; the five-slot view is non-authoritative Runtime infrastructure and adds no source classification.
Parent-child ordering and candidate generation precede rules, required-subdivision checks, degree consistency and recursive internal validation; the view performs none of those checks.

Normal-impulse rules refer across Waves 1-5 and the extension section calls an impulse five-wave while permitting 9, 13 or more visible swings; five logical candidate positions are therefore distinct from visible swings and validated waves.
Parent-child order and inspection of each proposed wave are protected concepts, while validation, degree consistency, internals and unresolved visibility remain separate.

locked_runtime_view_policy.cardinality: Exactly five ordered child subjects; all other counts raise NormalImpulseFiveSlotCardinalityError as Runtime contract misuse.
locked_runtime_view_policy.binding_identity: view.binding is the exact supplied binding object.
locked_runtime_view_policy.parent_identity: The exact parent reference remains available only through that binding.
locked_runtime_view_policy.position_identity: position_1 through position_5 directly return binding.ordered_children indexes zero through four.
locked_runtime_view_policy.position_meaning: Caller-proposed ordinal validation positions only; no Elliott wave validity.
locked_runtime_view_policy.immutability: Frozen and slotted at ordinary API level; ordinary subclass construction is sealed.
locked_runtime_view_policy.copy: copy and deepcopy preserve the same immutable live view identity.
locked_runtime_view_policy.replacement: Dataclass replacement creates a distinct untrusted view and revalidates exact type and cardinality.
locked_runtime_view_policy.serialization: Default pickle is rejected; JSON-compatible records and explicit reconstruction are audit-only untrusted data.
